item.title: Neil Sedaka, “Breaking Up Is Hard to Do” and “Laughter in the Rain” Singer-Songwriter, Dies at 86
item.description: The Brooklynite's esteemed body of work also includes "Calendar Girl," "Oh! Carol," "Love Will Keep Us Together," "Where the Boys Are," "Bad Blood" and "Solitaire."

item.description: Inside this week's biggest Hollywood premieres, parties and openings.

item.title: What Sparked Paramount’s Investigation of Jeff Shell
item.description: A whistleblower who tipped the company's leadership that its president was allegedly leaking confidential info had broached the possibility of a reality show at the studio.

item.title: Deep Frieze: The Art Festival’s Greatest Works May Just Be the Outfits
item.description: Thousands poured into the Santa Monica airport to attend the opening of LA’s sprawling art show. Heads were definitely turned — just not always at the stuff inside the frames.

item.title: All of ‘The Beauty’ Cast & Characters: Ashton Kutcher, Evan Peters, Bella Hadid and More in Ryan Murphy’s Body Horror Series
item.description: The FX show, adapted by Murphy and longtime collaborator Matt Hodgson from the comic book, explores the extremes people will go to achieve perfection — with a star-studded cast.

item.title: Singer Erin LeCount on ‘Pareidolia,’ Giving Teens A Space to be “Hysterical” and Those ‘Heated Rivalry’ Edits
item.description: The British singer also released a “gut punch” new single, “Alice,” about love and addiction: “When you struggle with the same thing, there's this intense bond that happens that feels like nobody else in the world could possibly understand.”

item.title: ACE Eddie Awards for Editing: ‘One Battle After Another,’ ‘Sinners’ Win Top Prizes
item.description: The top two Oscar contenders each had a category to themselves, setting up a showdown for the Academy Awards.
